# Infrastructure Checklist: Production Deployment Plan

**Purpose**: Validate infrastructure and operations requirement quality before task generation
**Created**: 2026-06-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are production service layout requirements complete for public services, internal-only services, migration jobs, Postgres, MinIO, networks, and exposed ports? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001..FR-003, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK002 Are Docker Compose hardening requirements complete for health checks, restart policy, resource limits, log rotation, private networking, and public endpoint exposure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK003 Are persistent volume requirements complete for ownership, backup inclusion/exclusion, restore expectations, encryption expectation, and disk-full behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §Persistent Volume]
- [ ] CHK004 Are migration runbook requirements complete for preflight, backup evidence, execution, verification, failure handling, and rollback decision points? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §Migration Runbook]
- [ ] CHK005 Are restore/rollback rehearsal requirements complete enough to block `infra_smoke_ready` when rehearsal is missing, failed, or inconclusive? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Contract §Blocking Gates]
- [ ] CHK006 Are first-smoke requirements complete for liveness, readiness, migration state, Postgres persistence, MinIO persistence, upload finalization, no side effects, cleanup, and evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010..FR-018, Quickstart §8..§11]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the distinction between public endpoint reachability and user rollout readiness unambiguous across spec, plan, and readiness contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001a/FR-022, Contract §Public Endpoint Rule]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the `infra_smoke_ready` verdict clearly bounded against forbidden verdicts such as `production_ready`, `user_rollout_ready`, and `internal_user_pilot_ready`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Contract §Readiness Verdicts]
- [ ] CHK009 Are "production-like" environment expectations clear enough to guide backup, restore, rollback, and smoke rehearsal tasks? [Clarity, Spec §US2/US4, Data Model §Deployment Environment]
- [ ] CHK010 Are internal smoke identity/device requirements clear enough to prevent reuse of real users, desktop uploader credentials, or dev seed credentials? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012a, Data Model §Smoke Identity And Device]
- [ ] CHK011 Are degraded-awareness requirements for MediaScribe and Langfuse clear about what is recorded and what must not block accepted `012` ingest smoke? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Data Model §Degraded-Awareness Status]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do the scope requirements consistently preserve `012` ingest boundary without pulling in `013` auth, `014` uploader, `015` processing, dashboard, sharing, retention, deletion, or driver packaging? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012/FR-021, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK013 Are backup, restore, rollback, cleanup, and residue-accounting requirements consistent with deletion-truth and lifecycle-accounting constitution gates? [Consistency, Constitution §IV, Spec §FR-018]

- [ ] CHK015 Are public exposure requirements consistent with secret/log redaction and evidence safety requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001a/FR-014/FR-016]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Are success criteria measurable enough to distinguish `not_ready`, `blocked`, and `infra_smoke_ready` without implementation interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001..SC-012]
- [ ] CHK017 Are compose/config validation success criteria measurable for missing secrets, dev defaults, internal service exposure, and Rec-owned storage boundaries? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Quickstart §2..§3]
- [ ] CHK018 Are restore/rollback rehearsal criteria measurable enough to produce pass, blocked, failed, or residue/follow-up outcomes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005/SC-009]
- [ ] CHK019 Are smoke artifact cleanup criteria measurable enough to determine whether cleanup passed or truthful residue was recorded? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010/SC-011]

## Scenario And Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for DNS/TLS mismatch, public endpoint exposure before readiness, internal service exposure, and wrong-host scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for partial migration, failed readiness, missing bucket, storage credential mismatch, disk-full behavior, and rollback halt states? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for smoke cleanup failures, residue ownership, and follow-up evidence when artifacts cannot be removed immediately? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, Data Model §Cleanup Record]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for optional/future dependency degradation without weakening active Rec Postgres/MinIO readiness gates? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019, Data Model §Degraded-Awareness Status]
